story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Olivia skipped into the sunny garden, where colorful puzzle pieces were scattered across the soft green grass. She wanted to build the tallest tower, but the pieces were everywhere.

[emotion:QT/afraid] "This is too hard," she whispered, feeling worried.

[emotion:QT/shy] A girl named Mia walked over slowly. "I can help! I know where the big pieces go," Mia said.

[emotion:QT/happy] "Really? You want to help me?" Olivia asked, feeling grateful.

Together, they sorted every piece — Olivia placed the wide ones on the bottom, Mia stacked the tall ones on top. [emotion:QT/happy] Because they worked together, the tower stood strong and beautiful. [gesture:clapping] Both girls clapped loudly. [emotion:QT/happy] Olivia felt so proud.

wrong_answers: She wanted to plant some flowers.
She wanted to find a hidden treasure.

wrong_answers: Her mom came to help her.

wrong_answers: She was afraid of the sun.
She did not like the color green.

questions.question: How do you think Olivia felt when Mia said, 'I can help!'?
questions.correct_answer: Olivia felt grateful and happy because Mia wanted to help.

questions.question: What was this story mostly about?

wrong_answers: This story was about a girl who played alone in a garden.

takeaways: Asking a friend for help makes hard things easier.
Working together and taking turns helps us finish what we start.
Being kind to someone new is how great friendships begin.
